title: Lemon Chicken with Masala Chickpeas
ingredients: 3-4 skinless chicken breasts (total weight about 600g/1lb 5oz), cut into chunks
2 x 400g (14oz) cans of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
TO SERVE: nigella seeds, coriander leaves
method: In a small bowl, pour the lemon juice over the chicken chunks, add the salt and mix.

Spray a sauté pan with oil and stir-fry the chicken over a high heat for 5 minutes. Add the curry paste, stir in, then reduce the heat and gently sizzle the chicken and curry paste together for 2 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes, measured boiling water, chickpeas and garlic granules. Stir well and bring up to a fast simmer.
Simmer the curry for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from the heat, then add the mango chutney and the spinach. Stir everything together until the spinach is wilted, then serve sprinkled with nigella seeds and coriander.
notes: Bulk out with extra vegetables such as butternut squash, sweet potato, mushrooms, peppers or carrots — add them in step 3 with the chopped tomatoes.
